criteria.claim: SNpp16 selectively drives DVM motor neurons, reliably from k=7
criteria.R1: targeted NT sign inversion, k=7: DVMn in band in >=4/5 draws; steering, b1, DLMn each < 1 Hz
criteria.R2: relay-layer parameter sweep [('tau_m_ms', 5.0), ('tau_m_ms', 10.0), ('tau_m_ms', 40.0), ('v_thresh_gap_mV', 4.0), ('v_thresh_gap_mV', 10.0), ('refractory_ms', 1.0), ('refractory_ms', 5.0)], k=7: steering, b1, DLMn each < 1 Hz at every setting
criteria.R3: fresh draws (seed base 50000): k* within 1 of 5, and k=7 in band in >=4/5
